whyItMatters: URL connection strings with userinfo keep the password in the repository, in CI logs, and in backups long after the code is deployed.
actions: Stop putting the password in the URL; read it from a secret manager at run time.
Prefer connection options that accept a separate credential source.
verification: Confirm no new URLs with userinfo appear in the repository history or current tree, and confirm the rotated credential no longer authenticates (owner-side check, outside this dataset).
